title: Senate blocks proposal on transgender athletes during voting bill session
desc: The Senate has blocked a proposal that would ban transgender athletes from playing in women’s sports.

title: Cubans say every day is a struggle for survival as they face blackouts, water and fuel shortages
desc: Blackouts have been common for years, but now, since U.S. President Donald Trump imposed an oil blockade on Cuba in hopes of forcing the country’s collapse, the interruptions have become more frequent, longer, sometimes engulfing the whole country.

desc: Iran says the attack, which wounded dozens, was in response to a strike on its own Natanz nuclear site.

title: IGP orders PPBS to probe alleged assault on artist Ibrahim Mahama
desc: The Inspector-General of Police (IGP), Mr. Christian Tetteh-Yohuno, has directed the Police Professional Standards Bureau (PPSB) to launch an investigation into the alleged assault on artist Ibrahim Mahama in Tamale.

title: Bennu is forcing scientists to rethink everything about asteroids
desc: NASA’s study of Bennu reveals why its rocky surface behaves like sand. The answer lies in cracks deep inside its boulders.

title: Eating less protein may slow tumor growth in damaged livers
desc: Reducing protein intake may slow the progression of liver cancer, according to a study that reveals how ammonia fuels tumors.

title: US Deploys Armed Drones, 200 Troops To Nigeria For Operation Against Terrorists - Report
desc: The United States has deployed multiple MQ-9 Reaper drones and about 200 military personnel to Nigeria to provide intelligence and training support to Nigerian forces battling insurgency in the country’s northern region, according to a report by Reuters. The report, published on Saturday, cited both US and Nigerian officials as confirming that the deployment is strictly limited to surveillance and advisory roles, with no American troops involved in frontline combat or drone strike missions.

title: Liverpool player ratings vs Brighton: Danny Welbeck at the double! Virgil van Dijk and Ibrahima Konate fall asleep in dismal defeat for Arne Slot's side
desc: Liverpool were beaten 2-1 by Brighton and Hove Albion at the Amex Stadium on Saturday, as a Danny Welbeck brace gave the Seagulls all three points. It was a disjointed performance from the Reds, despite Milos Kerkez's goal, after Hugo Ekitike was injured within the first 10 minutes.
